data.text: I’m in: I’ll choose 15 tons and donate the full $15,000 to the clinic, on the agreed plan of Kate, Jack, and Emma taking 15 each and Luke taking zero. With our neighbors’ treatment at stake, I can support this one-time exception. I’ll also keep to 6 tons next month if the lake starts at 80, then 10 once it’s back at 100, provided we all follow those limits. Let’s share the donation receipts alongside our catches. Luke, please give your final confirmation of zero so we’re all clear before choosing.
